free_tier.stated: No free tier. Micro is USD 0.10 a month (0.000135 an hour) with 128 MB RAM and 1 GB NVMe; a USD 3 minimum top-up is required after registration.

egress.terms: No byte cap: the vendor states it gives no GB or TB number and uses network performance tiers with a fair-use shaping rule that steps the speed down from 100 Mbit/s towards 10 Mbit/s after sustained use.

interface_detail: NAT KVM VPS: 2 TCP and 2 UDP external ports on the hypervisor's public IPv4, the first TCP port mapped to port 22.
tooling: Any SSH client; a web panel shows the mapped ports.
chaining: Two TCP and two UDP external ports on a shared NAT IPv4; UDP is available, so one UDP port can carry a WireGuard endpoint. Private /24 mesh between locations over WireGuard.

limits.value: fair-use shaping: after 1 hour at 100 Mbit/s the cap drops to 90 Mbit/s, stepping down to 10 Mbit/s; 10 Mbit/s of headroom per hour is added back

limits_note: Network tiers are low, medium and high; the speeds depend on the location.
binding_note: No byte cap is published; the binding limit is the fair-use speed step-down.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the registration page was not readable. The vendor states it has no objection to a free or disposable email and uses a merchant of record for payment; a USD 3 minimum top-up follows registration.

reliability_note: The vendor describes the service as a no-SLA budget service on older hardware with CPU, disk IOPS and network limits.
